text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I have decided. As for my birthday gift... 
I would like an iron ball. The exact same 
specifications as the one you possess.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you sure that's enough?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You got a new one last month, didn't 
you? One with better hardness and 
weight—giving you far more feedback.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then I assume you've already prepared a 
portable "iron ball case" as well?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...A-As for that, we're still carefully 
screening manufacturers...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Leave that to me as well. 
Hortensia's color changes as it matures, 
doesn't it? Let's tailor it with a hue 
that retains more blue.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...With a case, they should be suitable 
for everyday use. Please do not leave what 
I am giving you to sit merely as 
decorations."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course! I'll carry it with me every 
day! —For my sake, so I can become an 
Umamusume who surpasses even you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle... I hope those words do not 
remain mere "decoration."
